text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Constructed controls · intersection scope · matched PSI and KS
30 paired streams per cell; points and 95% Wilson intervals. Source substitution begins at delivery block 6 and may cause only a small feature-distribution difference. Natural
drift accuracy is not measured. Each standalone method has alpha .05 over 20 looks; scopes are separate comparisons. Zero observed events does not establish zero risk. Exact-
target recovery is defined only for the intersection scope. CSV also retains pre-intervention alerts.
